about_the_game:
About this game




The power of light lies in your hands

A cosmic horror looms above and is slowly plunging the world into an endless abyss. Shadows stretch, the land fades away. But with the power of light in your hands, you are the final beacon against this emerging threat.

Will you drive back the void, or be lost within it?

Survive the endless night

Armed with your lunar lantern, the only weapon capable of piercing the void, you must navigate the darkness, battle enemies, and awaken the lunar pillars to purge the forest of its suffocating fog. But as the night deepens, so does the abyss, and the threats lurking within grow ever stronger.

Gather light to fuel your lantern—both a weapon and a guiding beacon. The more you absorb, the brighter you shine. But every shot drains your power, dimming your glow. Aim wisely, or risk being consumed by the void.

Discover perks and upgrades

Scattered across the forest, moonflowers hold hidden perks-unlocked by offering a portion of your light. Collect them to grow stronger and gain the upper hand in your fight for survival.

Different perks highlight different playstyles. So be on the lookout and pick out the ones that suit you best.

short_description: Wield your magical lantern and survive the endless night in this 2,5D roguelike. While a cosmic entity is slowly corrupting the moon the world is drowning in darkness only you can overcome. Collect perks and fuel your lantern with light to grow stronger and to fight against the outwordly intruders.
